caseNameFull: Fong, Guardian ad litem v. Dulles, Secretary of State
attorneys: Joseph S. Hertogs for petitioners., Solicitor General Sobeloff for respondent.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certio-rari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment of the Court of Appeals is vacated and the case is remanded to the District Court for a new trial in accordance with the Govern*942ment’s suggestion.

Joseph S. Hertogs for petitioners. Solicitor General Sobeloff for respondent.
